---
title: "Exploring_Flanders_data"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
#read in data

library(dplyr)

#filter toevoegen voor Vlaanderen

data_all_Flanders <- read.csv("~/GitHub/Flanders_use_case/_preprocessing/data/raw/data_all_Flanders.csv")





overzicht <- data_all_Flanders %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(total_records = sum(`n_records`, na.rm = TRUE))

library(ggplot2)

overzicht$year <- as.numeric(as.character(overzicht$year))

b <- ggplot(overzicht, aes(x = year, y = total_records)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(min(overzicht$year), max(overzicht$year), by = 10)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Total Number of Records per Year",
    y = "Number of Records"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

```{r}

df <- data_all_Flanders

df$year <- as.numeric(as.character(df$year))

top_publishers <- df %>%
  filter(year >= 2000) %>%
  group_by(publisher) %>%
  summarise(totaal = sum(`n_records`, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(totaal)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  pull(publisher)

df_top <- df %>%
  filter(year >= 2000, publisher %in% top_publishers) %>%
  group_by(year, publisher) %>%
  summarise(totaal_records = sum(`n_records`, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

library(ggplot2)

a <- ggplot(df_top, aes(x = year, y = totaal_records, fill = publisher)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 Publishers by Number of Records (Since 2000)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Records",
    fill = "Publisher"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

top_publishers <- df %>%
  group_by(publisher) %>%
  summarise(total_records = sum(`n_records`, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_records)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

top_publishers

write.csv("~/GitHub/Flanders_use_case/_preprocessing/data/raw/top_publishers.csv")
```
